skill.name: lark-doc
skill.description: Create, search, fetch, update, and manage media for Lark or Feishu cloud documents through lark-cli workflows.
skill.summary: Work with Lark documents, media, Wiki links, and resource search from an AI coding assistant.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown false positives from examples, inline code, placeholder URLs, and human-readable Chinese documentation. I confirmed the parent-directory references that instruct agents to load sibling skills outside the audited lark-doc package. No prompt injection or hidden encoded payload evidence was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Bundle the shared Lark guidance inside this package or declare version-pinned marketplace dependencies instead of runtime ../ reads.

remediation.issue: Destructive write operations need stronger guardrails
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before overwrite, delete_range, owner transfer, permission changes, and media uploads.

飞书开放平台中,不同类型的文档有不同的 URL 格式和 Token 处理方式。在进行文档操作(如添加评论、下载文件等)时,必须先获取正确的 `file_token`。
| `/docx/` | `https://example.larksuite.com/docx/doxcnxxxxxxxxx`    | `file_token` | URL 路径中的 token
| `/doc/` | `https://example.larksuite.com/doc/doccnxxxxxxxxx`     | `file_token` | URL 路径中的 token 直
| `/wiki/` | `https://example.larksuite.com/wiki/wikcnxxxxxxxxx`    | `wiki_token` | ⚠️ **不能直接使用**,需
| `/sheets/` | `https://example.larksuite.com/sheets/shtcnxxxxxxxxx`  | `file_token` | URL 路径中的 toke
| `/drive/folder/` | `https://example.larksuite.com/drive/folder/fldcnxxxx` | `folder_token` | URL 路
知识库链接(`/wiki/TOKEN`)背后可能是云文档、电子表格、多维表格等不同类型的文档。**不能直接假设 URL 中的 token 就是 file_token**,必须先查询实际类型和真实 to
1. **使用 `wiki.spaces.get_node` 查询节点信息**
```bash
- `node.obj_type`:文档类型(docx/doc/sheet/bitable/slides/file/mindnote)
- `node.obj_token`:**真实的文档 token**(用于后续操作)
- `node.title`:文档标题
3. **根据 `obj_type` 使用对应的 API**
| `docx` | 新版云文档 | `drive file.comments.*`、`docx.*` |
| `doc` | 旧版云文档 | `drive file.comments.*` |
| `sheet` | 电子表格 | `sheets.*` |
| `bitable` | 多维表格 | `bitable.*` |
| `slides` | 幻灯片 | `drive.*` |
| `file` | 文件 | `drive.*` |
| `mindnote` | 思维导图 | `drive.*` |

content.value_statement: Lark document work often spans search, creation, updates, and media handling across several commands. This skill provides guided Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows for safe Lark document operations.
actual_capabilities: Create Lark documents from Lark-flavored Markdown.
Fetch document content and return Markdown or readable output.
Update documents with append, overwrite, replace, insert, and delete modes.
Search Lark docs, Wiki pages, and spreadsheet resources.
Insert local images or files at the end of documents.
Download document media and whiteboard thumbnails by token.
limitations: Requires configured lark-cli and authenticated Lark permissions.
Cannot edit existing whiteboard content directly; it hands off to lark-whiteboard.
Some write modes can overwrite content, so users should confirm destructive changes.
Media handling depends on file size, token validity, and Lark API access.

use_cases.title: Create Project Documents
use_cases.description: Turn outlines, meeting notes, and plans into structured Lark documents with headings, tables, and callouts.

use_cases.title: Find Workspace Resources
use_cases.description: Search Lark docs, Wiki pages, and spreadsheets before choosing the right follow-up tool.

use_cases.title: Maintain Living Documentation
use_cases.description: Fetch, update, and append sections while preserving media blocks and collaborative history where possible.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Lark document titled Project Plan with goals, milestones, risks, and owners. Use clear headings and simple tables.

prompt_templates.title: Search Workspace Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Lark for documents and spreadsheets about quarterly planning. Return titles, links, object types, and next recommended actions.

prompt_templates.title: Update a Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch this Lark document, replace the Risks section with the revised text, and keep media blocks unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Media and Whiteboards
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Lark document from this outline, insert the local architecture image, then add two blank whiteboards for follow-up editing.

output_examples.input: Create a project kickoff document from my outline.
output_examples.output: The skill creates a titled Lark document with sections for objectives, stakeholders, timeline, risks, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Find the budget spreadsheet named Q3 Forecast.
output_examples.output: The skill searches Lark cloud resources, identifies matching spreadsheet entries, and returns links for handoff to the sheet workflow.

output_examples.input: Add this diagram to the design document.
output_examples.output: The skill uploads the local file, appends it to the document, and reports the inserted file name and token.

best_practices: Confirm user intent before create, update, delete, overwrite, media insert, or permission changes.
Use small targeted updates to preserve comments, media, and collaboration history.
Resolve Wiki links to their real object type before selecting the next tool.
anti_patterns: Do not use overwrite when a smaller append, insert, or replace operation is enough.
Do not pass Wiki URLs to media insert when a returned document ID is available.
Do not treat search totals as exact counts after local filtering or de-duplication.

faq.question: What account does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the configured lark-cli identity and permissions. Some actions require user identity or bot identity.

faq.question: Can it create a document from Markdown?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates Lark documents from Lark-flavored Markdown, including tables, callouts, images, and blank whiteboards.

faq.question: Can it edit existing documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports append, replace, insert, delete, and overwrite modes for documents the active identity can edit.

faq.question: Can it find spreadsheets?
faq.answer: Yes. Search can locate spreadsheet resources, but spreadsheet content work should move to the Lark Sheets workflow.

faq.question: Can it edit whiteboards?
faq.answer: It can create blank whiteboards and return tokens. Existing whiteboard editing uses the lark-whiteboard workflow.

faq.question: What should users confirm before running it?
faq.answer: Confirm the target document, write mode, destructive overwrite or delete actions, media files, and permission changes.
